description: Retrieves flight route information from www.flightsfrom.com for any airport, including destinations, airlines, schedules, and route details.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_airport_routes: Get all routes from a specific airport (requires airport_code); 参数: include_airlines, airport_code; 必填: 无
  - get_airport_info: Get basic airport information (requires airport_code); 参数: airport_code; 必填: 无
  - search_destinations: Search destinations by country or city (requires airport_code + country or city); 参数: airport_code, country, city; 必填: 无
  - get_route_details: Get details for a specific route (requires from_airport + to_airport); 参数: from_airport, to_airport; 必填: 无

include_airlines.description:
Include detailed airline information in the response.
Used by get_airport_routes.

airport_code.description:
IATA airport code (3 letters, e.g., 'JFK', 'LHR', 'HIA').
Required for get_airport_routes, get_airport_info, and search_destinations.

country.description:
Filter destinations by country name (partial match, case-insensitive).
Used by search_destinations.

city.description:
Filter destinations by city name (partial match, case-insensitive).
Used by search_destinations.

from_airport.description:
Origin airport IATA code.
Required for get_route_details.

to_airport.description:
Destination airport IATA code.
Required for get_route_details.
